calls.title: Paradigm + GrowthBook
calls.summary: In this meeting, the team agreed on a flexible, user-based pricing model with a minimum 12-month enterprise contract starting at $50,000. They planned an initial rollout with around 50 users, scaling up as adoption grows. Christian Liebenow committed to providing a proposal with pricing details and compliance documentation by the end of the next business day, which will include a rate table for 50 to 150 users. Eric Storck stressed the need for proving value with shorter contracts initially. The team discussed selecting Growth Book due to its cost-effective pricing and flexibility, avoiding vendor lock-in. They also addressed the importance of compliance and security documentation to assist Paradigm’s InfoSec review.
calls.keywords: Feature Flagging, Pricing Model, User Licensing, Security Compliance, Cloud Hosting, Contract Terms
calls.action_items:
**Christian Liebenow**
Send security and compliance documentation including SoC2 and data governance policies to Paradigm’s security and legal teams (08:23)
Provide a detailed pricing rate table with volume discounts for various user tiers (50, 100, 150 users) to assist Paradigm’s budgeting (10:45)
Prepare and send draft proposal and legal order form/terms for Paradigm review within 1-2 business days, despite upcoming travel (33:07)
Clarify user seat policy—whether seats are assigned by name or can be reallocated within the organization (31:54)
Share customer ROI examples and business case experiences to support Paradigm’s internal justification process (29:26)

**Kenny Jinadu**
Provide detailed user counts broken down by teams and applications to inform phased rollout and licensing requirements (27:44)

**Eric Storck**
Coordinate internal budget clarification on expected user seat counts and investment levels to finalize order details (29:09)
